title: Check that both scheduled workflows have run on their schedule
goal: Confirm the scheduled workflows fire, or find why not
acceptance: After 2026-11-26 12:00 UTC, gh run list -R voidbrain/coordinator --event schedule shows a run of Maintenance freshness and of Refresh solution views
If either is missing, the cause is recorded and the record moves to Open
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one gh query after the date, more only if a run is missing. Not a measurement.
